formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): the earliest prominent strong anionic is Sodium Laureth Sulfate (7, ether type), so it is the defining anionic; it is buffered by the prominent mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate (3) and Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate (4) and the glucoside Lauryl Glucoside (6); no reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: SLES is listed last among the surfactants, behind two mild anionics and a glucoside, with Urea (2) high in the list: the chassis is mild-led and argues for low. Laureth-9 (5) recorded as an alcohol ethoxylate, not a C3 cleansing class/buffer.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate (bounded): one cationic conditioning polymer, Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride (15), plus trace Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil (21) and Urea (2) as humectant. C2 not met (no silicone, no prominent lipid, no pearlizing route).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The only polymer sits after Sodium Benzoate and the oil is last: little substantive slip is realistic (neighbor low).

weightPotential.rationale: Low: the only deposition routes are one late cationic starch polymer and a trace sunflower oil in last position, facing a buffered SLES/sulfosuccinate system.

depositionLoad.rationale: Cationic starch (15, after preservative) and sunflower oil (21, last).

persistence.rationale: Light polysaccharide polymer and trace liquid oil are weakly retained.

resetCapacity.rationale: Buffered C1 system with broad mild-anionic co-surfactants.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only light, late routes with moderate reset: low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families present, but the cationic starch sits after a preservative and the oil is the last ingredient (both trace), with no silicone, film or protein; combined residue is unlikely to be noticeable.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Formula is a comfort-route scalp architecture: Urea (2) and Laureth-9 (5, INCI name of polidocanol) prominent with a mild-led cleansing system; scalp_active requires an SC1 sensitive/dry claim. Lengths care-direction: nonspecific.

usageRole.rationale: Default; frequent possible with explicit frequency wording (cleansing not strong).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met: prominent Urea (2) is on both E4 lists; Laureth-9 (5) = polidocanol (comfort list) if the synonym is accepted (immaterial, Urea alone suffices).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.

formulaFacts.role: humectant; E4 comfort and humectant route
polidocanol (INCI Laureth-9); comfort-route candidate; not a C3 cleansing class
defining anionic (ether type), last prominent position

uncertainties: Laureth-9 read as the INCI name of polidocanol (E4 comfort list names 'Polidocanol'); immaterial because prominent Urea already satisfies both E4 lists.
